compatibility: Reliable publication uses Node.publishQuicReliable and opt-in publications inbound profile; datagram default remains.
Per-peer pre-admission FIFO may shed or report pressure; transport reliability begins after admission. No cross-stream ordering or durable replay.
GOAWAY discards/counts unsent publication FIFO; admitted streams retain existing drain semantics.
Remote subscription filters now obey per-peer max_quic_subscriptions; duplicate updates and unsubscribe remain valid at capacity.
Snapshot example is single-authority fixed bounded state and local injected outage using configured endpoints, not a general discovery or persistence protocol.
limits: No pushes/releases/public pin changes; inherited QUIC fairness promotion hold remains.
Local native arm64 Mac and Linux container gates; no hosted CI/native Windows/physical-network qualification.
Req/Rep pre-repair samples and CPU capture remain labeled historical; final exact-binary measurements are separate.
Raw trace/binaries/archives remain locally available at indexed original paths; durable copies retain metadata and raw text outputs.
